concerns.text: T019a (generate_manifest.py) depends on T011b (failure_cases_test.json). However, T011b is marked as 'FAILED: unspecified' and has no completion status. T019a cannot execute without the stratified test split produced by T011b. This creates a hard data-flow break in Phase 4.

T022 (merge_results.py) depends on T021 (run_baseline.py) and T019a (experiment_manifest.csv). T021 depends on T019a. T019a depends on T011b. Since T011b is incomplete, the entire US2 execution chain (T019a -> T021 -> T022) is blocked. The plan implies a linear flow that is currently broken at the US1/US2 boundary.

T026a (Model Fitting) depends on T022 (merge_results.py). T022 depends on T021 and T019a, which depend on T011b. With T011b incomplete, T026a has no input data. The statistical analysis phase (US3) is entirely blocked by the incomplete data split in US1.
T027b (Execute & Populate) depends on T022 and T011b. T011b is incomplete. T022 is blocked. This task cannot run, breaking the error taxonomy flow required for SC-004.
T029d (Execute Stratified Rates) depends on T029b, which depends on T022. T022 is blocked by T011b. The stratified success rate calculation (SC-002) cannot proceed.
T029h (Paired t-test/Wilcoxon) depends on T022. T022 is blocked. The primary statistical comparison (SC-001) is blocked.

T029f (Generate Final Report) depends on T026b, T029c, T029h, T029d, T027d, T027c, T030a, T030c, T047, T064, T065, T067, T068, T066. Most of these (T026b, T029c, T029h, T029d, T027d) depend on T022, which is blocked by T011b. The final report generation is impossible until T011b is resolved.

T060 (Orchestration Script) depends on 'Completion of Phases 0-5'. Phase 3 (US1) is incomplete (T011b failed). Phase 4 (US2) and Phase 5 (US3) are blocked by US1. The orchestration script cannot be implemented or tested until the data flow is unblocked.

T011b is marked 'FAILED: unspecified'. It is the producer of 'failure_cases_test.json', 'failure_cases_train.json', and 'failure_cases_val.json'. All downstream tasks in US2 and US3 are consumers of these artifacts. The task must be resolved (completed or redefined) before any consumer tasks can be valid.

T015b (Schema Validation) depends on T013 (distill_rules.py). T013 depends on T011b. T011b is incomplete. T015b cannot validate rules that haven't been generated because the input data split is missing.
T057 (Enforce Strict Data Flow) depends on T011b. It validates inputs for T013. Since T011b is incomplete, T057 cannot be executed or verified.
T062 (Paired-Data Integrity Check) depends on T019a and T021. T019a depends on T011b. T011b is incomplete. The integrity check cannot run.
T070 (Baseline Resource Verification) depends on T021 and T022. T021 depends on T019a, which depends on T011b. T011b is incomplete. This task is blocked.
T063 (Sensitivity Analysis for Censoring) depends on T022 and T029a. T022 is blocked by T011b. The sensitivity analysis cannot run.
T064 (Cross-Validation) depends on T013 and T022. T013 depends on T011b. T022 depends on T011b. T011b is incomplete. Cross-validation is blocked.
T065 (Baseline Failure Mode Analysis) depends on T021 and T011b. T011b is incomplete. Analysis is blocked.
T067 (Effect Size Verification) depends on T022. T022 is blocked by T011b. Effect size calculation is blocked.
T068 (Resource Correlation) depends on T030a and T022. T022 is blocked by T011b. Correlation analysis is blocked.
T053 (Sensitivity Analysis for Distillation) depends on T013 and T019a. T013 depends on T011b. T019a depends on T011b. T011b is incomplete. Sensitivity analysis is blocked.

T055 (Executive Summary Generator) depends on T029f, T026b, T027d, T027c, T047. T029f depends on T026b, T029c, T029h, T029d, T027d, T027c, T030a, T030c, T047, T064, T065, T067, T068, T066. Most of these depend on T022, which depends on T011b. T011b is incomplete. Executive summary generation is blocked.
